reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: §1(a) engages Contractor on a task-by-task basis under mutually agreed SOWs, §3(a) compensates on a time-and-materials basis for Services performed, and §6(a) permits termination on 15 days' notice — no minimum, take-or-pay, shortfall or volume cap appears on the Company.
Consistent with the compliant classification, the redline is unchanged from the original paragraphs and no counterparty comment is proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

Rationale is accurate and appropriately notes as internal context only that future Statements of Work could introduce minimum-hour or retainer floors, with §1(a) giving the Agreement precedence over conflicting SOW terms; this is recorded in the rationale rather than raised as a deviation.
